title: ART FORGE - Tool for Local LLM Generation. Prompt to 2D to 3D to 3D motion
author: couldgiveaflyingfck
selftext:
# ArtForge - A FREE, local LLM AI game-art studio for Windows

I've been working on ArtForge, a local AI-powered game-art studio that runs on your own GPU. No cloud dependency, no subscriptions, no ads. Just your machine doing the work.

Here's what it can do -

* **Type it. Generate it. Pick the best.** Choose between fast drafts and quality artwork, with 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, Painted, and Showpiece quality levels.
* **AI Art Director.** Every generated image gets evaluated, and the duds are automatically sent back for another attempt.
* **One-word generation keys.** Weapon, Goodie, Rig, and Animate. Type a word and generate batches of legendary weapons, glossy collectibles, or rigged characters.
* **Mystery Button.** One click, secret prompts, completely unexpected artwork. You never know what you're going to get.
* **3D conversion.** Turn images into textured 3D models, inspect them from all four sides, rig them, and animate them.
* **Game-ready exports.** Export for game engines, Apple, Amiga IFF and palettes, sprite sheets, application icons, and 3D printing (STL / 3MF) and much more.
* **Built-in recorder.** Capture your creative sessions in compact, high-quality AV1 video.
* **Local-first design.** Dark theme, no cloud, no subscription, no advertising. Your artwork stays on your machine.

  
I am not ready to share the Animated models Running, Fighting, Shooting. Also doesn't pixel people crazy good. I've purposely not show the good stuff. Auto snap / mount weapons, etc.

This is a fantastic tool to generate your own art assets for your game.

HAS FULL CLAUDE MPC BRIDGE ... plug it into your game and it starts pull assets as it needs them.

Right now I am looking for testers via my software is free. Donations are strongly encouraged. Anything helps. I have about $500 a month going out in subscriptions. I've been plugging this in to my other game dev sessions and Claude just pulls the assets out as they are needed.

I do have a scripting language / system so people can share "KEYS" that basically runs any style you need. Type your KEY in and it just auto generates what you need, from you pixel game, to maybe your racers, to your RPG .. from imagination, to prompt to 2D to 3D to 3D nothing to export.

I have maybe 6 weeks into this and around 400+ hours.
